# Release 1.0: Flipper Apps Catalog, iPhone + iPad + Apple Watch on the App Store

## Overview
- Owner request (2026-11-05): polish FliBuddy into a public 1.0. The
  Flipper app goes to the official Flipper Apps Catalog; the iPhone/iPad
  app with its Apple Watch companion goes to the App Store (paid Apple
  Developer account now exists). The Mac app follows later and is out of
  scope except where shared code changes.
- Scope: everything found by the pre-1.0 reviews (Flipper C code, host
  Swift code, App Store readiness, catalog requirements, UI/UX), the
  current design from the design artifact, store packaging, the public
  repository and the two submissions.
- Branch: `release-1.0` (from `main` at 7a78f93).

## Owner decisions (2026-11-05)
- Bundle ids stay `com.sokolachko.flibuddy` and
  `com.sokolachko.flibuddy.watchkitapp`; the owner reserves the name
  FliBuddy in App Store Connect now.
- App Review gets a separate test Bambuddy instance (not the studio's
  production one), filled with scanned spools; the owner sets it up. The
  app gains an inventory browser so a reviewer without a Flipper sees real
  content.
- iPad ships in 1.0 (device family 1,2), laid out for the large screen:
  tiles, no full-width rows (the new design already does this).
- HTTPS only on iPhone, iPad and Watch for 1.0: no App Transport Security
  exceptions. Plain HTTP may come back in an update.
- Public GitHub repo `sokogen/flipperzero-flibuddy`, MIT licence, privacy
  policy and support page on GitHub Pages of that repo.
- Catalog category NFC (was Tools).
- UI/UX: Claude reviews and fixes; the owner corrects before release.

## Calls made by Claude (owner may override)
- Store the API key with `kSecAttrAccessibleAfterFirstUnlockThisDeviceOnly`;
  an unreadable key is "unknown", never "empty".
- A stored core weight equal to the default is not persisted; installs
  that saved the old 325 g with no catalog entry migrate once to 242 g.
- The Flipper "get the host app" screen links by QR to the project page on
  GitHub Pages (stable before the App Store id exists), which links the
  App Store. The QR bitmap is generated at build time by a tool script; no
  QR library on the Flipper.
- The inventory browser is read-only in 1.0 (no edits from the list).
- A hidden launch argument fills the feed and inventory with fixtures for
  App Store screenshots and simulator UI checks; it is not reachable from
  the UI.
- The BLE return-value workaround for SDK 1.5.1 is gated at compile time
  on the API version: an unknown SDK fails the build instead of silently
  breaking Bluetooth.
- Build numbers come from `git rev-list --count HEAD`; marketing version
  1.0.0 (Flipper `fap_version` 1.0).
- The design synced on 2026-11-05 wins over the 2026-10-27 new spool card:
  an unknown tag offers New and Link to existing…, New adds the spool at
  its label weight ("Added to Bambuddy").
- iPhone is portrait-only in 1.0; the apps are English-only in 1.0.

## Context
- Reviews (2026-11-05, in this session): Flipper FAP review (C1 NFC stop
  flag, M1 BLE return value, M2 unsupported tags, M3 notification
  sequences), host review (C1 API-key deletion, M1–M5), App Store
  readiness audit, catalog research (flipperdevices/flipper-application-catalog
  `documentation/`, `AGENTS.md`, `tools/bundle.py`), UI/UX review.
- Design: `docs/design/source/*.dc.html` (synced from the design artifact
  on 2026-11-05; newer than the `.md` specs), `docs/design/flipper/flipper-ui.js`.
- Code: `flipper/src`, `host/Sources/FliBuddyCore`, `host/Sources/FliBuddyUI`,
  `host/Apple` (XcodeGen `project.yml`, `iOS/`, `Watch/`), `tools/`.
- Commands: `make test`, `make lint`, `make coverage`, `make apple-project
  apple-build`, `cd flipper && ufbt`.

## Development Approach
- TDD: failing test first for every behaviour change (C tests host-compiled
  in `flipper/tests`, Swift tests in `host/Tests`, Python in `tools/tests`).
- Hardware-only behaviour (NFC timing, BLE, background relaunch, the
  watch) gets a unit test of the logic plus a device check listed in the
  task; device checks are run by Claude where the device is reachable,
  otherwise listed for the owner.
- Each task ends with `make test` and `make lint` green; Apple UI tasks also
  `make apple-build`.
- All repository text in English; UI strings on the Flipper ASCII-only.
- Outward-facing steps (making the repo public, uploads to App Store
  Connect, the catalog PR) are confirmed with the owner right before.

## Implementation Steps

### Task 1: Design sources in the repo
- [ ] commit the synced design sources (`docs/design/source/`: new App Icon, Flipper and macOS pages, `support.js`, `ios-frame.jsx`; updated Spec, iPhone, iPad, Watch, `flibuddy-core.js`)

- [ ] restore the `--fb-side` colour that 7a78f93 changed by accident (`rgba(236,238,243,0.86)`)

### Task 2: Flipper NFC reader can hang (review C1)
- [ ] move the reader's thread flags off bit 0 (the SDK's sync pollers wait on and clear bit 0 of the calling thread)
- [ ] check `r->stopping` in every loop of `wait_gone` and `wait_for_tag`; bounded waits instead of `FuriWaitForever`
- [ ] fix the `nfc_read.h` comment about reads that "cannot be cancelled"
- [ ] write host tests for the stop logic that can run off-device (extract the loop decisions if needed)
- [ ] device check: exit and key presses with a spool lying on the Flipper, 50 times, no hang; USB and the stock BLE profile come back
- [ ] run `make test` and `ufbt`

### Task 3: Flipper robustness (review M2, M3, minors)
- [ ] unsupported tag (SAK not MIFARE Classic/Ultralight, read error with the tag still present): its own outcome "Unsupported tag", no error cue, no "Reading again"
- [ ] `notification_message_block(…, &sequence_empty)` before closing the notification record
- [ ] after "Lookup failed" and a scan taken without a host, forget the tag so the spool on the Flipper is read again
- [ ] ignore a host hello while the port is closed; flush `rx_queue` on port close
- [ ] USB restore failure logs instead of `furi_check`
- [ ] protocol version mismatch shown on the waiting screen ("Host speaks protocol N")
- [ ] remove the unreachable `AppErrorNone` branch; rename the `sb_` crypto prefix; fix `flipper/README.md` (chunk retries) and `PROTOCOL.md` (case-sensitive match) or the code, whichever is intended
- [ ] write tests for each change
- [ ] run `make test` and `ufbt`

### Task 4: Flipper BLE against future SDKs (review M1)
- [ ] gate the inverted `ble_gatt_characteristic_update` result on the SDK API version at compile time; an unknown API version fails the build with a message pointing at the check
- [ ] document the 1.5.1 `gap.c` workaround (`ble_wire.h`) with the same gate
- [ ] run `make test` and `ufbt`

### Task 5: API key survives locked launches (host C1, lead 2)
- [ ] `KeychainSecretStore`: add with `kSecAttrAccessibleAfterFirstUnlockThisDeviceOnly`; migrate existing items once with `SecItemUpdate`
- [ ] `SettingsStore.load`: a read error gives "key unknown", not an empty key; `save` never deletes or rewrites the key unless the key field was edited
- [ ] reload settings when protected data becomes available and when the scene becomes active
- [ ] the watch sync never sends an empty key unless the user cleared it; the receiver ignores an empty key otherwise
- [ ] write tests with a failing `SecretStore` (load, then save, then sync)
- [ ] run `make test`
